items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: Helen -- I think she sounded good with the band. I think she fit with the band -- you know what I mean? And, it would have been a good thing if she had stayed, you know?

ctx.x: And, she was sort of -- had sort of an easy-going attitude, and what-not, didn't she?
Helen -- I think she sounded good with the band. I think she fit with the band -- you know what I mean? And, it would have been a good thing if she had stayed, you know?
